name: pagerduty
description: Browse PagerDuty services, incidents, and change events.

PAGERDUTY_API_KEY.title: PagerDuty API key
PAGERDUTY_API_KEY.description: API user token from PagerDuty: User Profile, User Settings, API Access, Create API User Token.

PAGERDUTY_MCP_HOST.title: PagerDuty MCP host
PAGERDUTY_MCP_HOST.description: mcp.pagerduty.com for US accounts, or mcp.eu.pagerduty.com for EU service region accounts. Your API key is sent to this host, so enter only one of these two values.

endpointCheck.source: live probe of https://mcp.pagerduty.com/mcp and https://mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp: unauthenticated initialize returned HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate Bearer and a resource_metadata link; docs at https://docs.pagerduty.com/ai-automation/advance/pagerduty-mcp-server describe the API key header and say dynamic client registration is not supported
